evidence.claim: Objective text 'Forge another Spunky Scrapper Hammer for Cleetus Farnum.' is locale 5100488 and belongs to this quest (quest_dialog 5100486 offer, 5100489 complete).
Forging is the MatchThree minigame bound as const GAME = 139 in forging.rs; row 139 is 'Forging: Spunky Scrapper Hammer'.
A native run of this forging minigame produced a GameWon result and Cleetus turn-in for the hammer.
The draft craft_recipe recipe 11 was wrong: recipe 11 is the Your First Weapon recipe chain (notes/Research/Starting Quest Chains.md:14), and the repeat forge is a minigame, not a recipe craft.

objectives.note: Count 1 from 'another' (one more hammer). Replaces draft craft_recipe{recipe_id 11}. Requires the server's repeatable forge to accept a second run (unverified, see open).

objectives.note: Turn-in to the giver after the hammer is forged.
